# PostPlan

> Authenticated artifact publishing for agents. From documents, reports, and specifications to interactive bundled applications.

PostPlan accepts any self-contained HTML file up to 2 MB. Inline scripts are allowed and pinned by hash. Scripts cannot reach the network.

## Quick Start

1. Install the CLI: `npx postplan`
2. Download the skill file:
   ```sh
   cd <agents-global-config-dir>
   mkdir -p skills/postplan
   curl -o skills/postplan/SKILL.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/SKILL.md
   ```
3. Open https://postplan.mcking.in/cli/auth in the user's browser. Ask them to generate an API key and paste it back. If the browser does not open, share the link and ask them to open it manually.
4. Run: `postplan auth set <pasted-key> --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in`

If the skill file already exists, re-run the curl command from step 2. Diff before overwriting to preserve any local changes.

## Documentation

- [PostPlan Skill](https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/SKILL.md): Reading and uploading drafts, document rules, writing rules, anti-patterns, and error handling.

## API

- POST /api/uploads: upload or update a draft (bearer auth)
- GET /api/drafts: list drafts (bearer auth)
- GET /api/me: account info (bearer auth)
- GET /d/<id>: serve current version (public)
- GET /d/<id>/version/<n>: serve specific version (public)
